calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) as members_contacted
FROM fact_campaign_exposure
WHERE campaign_id = 19

SELECT SUM(net_amount) as total_spending
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE member_key IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_key
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure
  WHERE campaign_id = 19
)
AND sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'

WITH campaign_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_key
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure
  WHERE campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT cm.member_key) as members_contacted,
  COALESCE(SUM(fsl.net_amount), 0) as spending_4_24_may_2026
FROM campaign_members cm
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON cm.member_key = fsl.member_key 
  AND fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_id) as campaigns_found,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) as distinct_members,
  MIN(contact_ts_utc) as earliest_contact,
  MAX(contact_ts_utc) as latest_contact
FROM fact_campaign_exposure
WHERE campaign_id = 19

WITH campaign_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_key
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure
  WHERE campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as sales_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) as receipts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cm.member_key) as members_with_sales,
  MIN(fsl.sale_date) as earliest_sale,
  MAX(fsl.sale_date) as latest_sale
FROM campaign_members cm
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON cm.member_key = fsl.member_key 
  AND fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
